Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. # SmartBFT Trace Instrumentation Guide

## Instrumented Events

| Event | Source File | Function / Location |
|---|---|---|
| `propose` | `internal/bft/controller.go` | Leader proposes a new request |
| `decide` | `internal/bft/controller.go` | Node reaches decision on a sequence number |
| `update_view` | `internal/bft/controller.go` | Current view number is updated |
| `update_decisions` | `internal/bft/controller.go` | Decisions map is updated after commit |
| `pre_prepare` | `internal/bft/view.go` | PrePrepare message is processed |
| `view_change_start` | `internal/bft/viewchanger.go` | Node initiates a view change |
| `vc_deliver` | `internal/bft/viewchanger.go` | ViewChange message is delivered |
| `vc_validate` | `internal/bft/viewchanger.go` | ViewChange quorum is validated |
| `vc_same_seq` | `internal/bft/viewchanger.go` | View change for same sequence detected |
| `enter_new_view` | `internal/bft/viewchanger.go` | Node enters a new view after VC completes |
| `hb_timeout` | `internal/bft/heartbeatmonitor.go` | Leader heartbeat timeout fires |
| `change_role` | `internal/bft/heartbeatmonitor.go` | Node role changes (leader/follower) |

## How to Add a Field to an Existing Event

1. Find the `Emit(...)` call for the event in the source file listed above.
2. Add the new key-value pair to the map passed to `Emit`.
3. Re-run `bash /Users/tess/dev/Specula/case-studies/smartbft/.specula-output/harness/run.sh`.

## How to Add a New Event

1. Find an existing `Emit(...)` call near the location you want to instrument.
2. Copy the block and paste it at the new location.
3. Change the `"event"` key value to the new event name.
4. Add or remove fields as needed.
5. Re-run `bash /Users/tess/dev/Specula/case-studies/smartbft/.specula-output/harness/run.sh`.

## How to Rebuild

```
bash /Users/tess/dev/Specula/case-studies/smartbft/.specula-output/harness/run.sh
```

This resets the repo, re-applies the patch, rebuilds, runs tests, and reports trace line counts.

## Note on hb_timeout

The `hb_timeout` event fires only when `LeaderHeartbeatTimeout` elapses without a heartbeat from
the leader. Use `TestTLATraceHBTimeout`, which drives a manual/fake clock to trigger the timeout
without waiting for wall-clock time.
